title: A bill to redesignate a facility of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
official_summary: (Sec. 1) This bill redesignates the Independent Verification and Validation Facility of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in Fairmont, West Virginia, as the "Katherine Johnson Independent Verification and Validation Facility."

summary.headline: A 2018 law renamed NASA's Independent Verification and Validation Facility in Fairmont, West Virginia, after Katherine Johnson.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes the official name of a NASA facility in Fairmont, West Virginia, to the Katherine Johnson Independent Verification and Validation Facility. It does not change the facility's work, staffing, or funding. The summary provided describes only this renaming.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 11, 2018, and the renaming took effect on that date.
